requires.n: Cards Allowing a Creature to Tap for Free

requires.battlefieldCardState: as a copy of Academy Manufactor, or previously used to create a copy

1486-3734-4231-4875--119--229.description:
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap two untapped creatures you control.
Magda triggers twice due to Conspiracy, creating six Treasure tokens, six Food tokens, and six three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for Phyrexian Metamorph. If this is a clone effect, have it copy Academy Manufactor.
Use the permanent that allows you to tap creatures for free to tap an untapped creature you control.
Magda triggers due to Conspiracy, creating at least six Treasure tokens, at least three Food tokens, and at least three Clue tokens.
Activate Magda by sacrificing five Treasures, searching your library for any creature and putting it onto the battlefield.
Repeat from step 4.
Once you have sufficient excess Treasure tokens, you may activate Magda additional times to search your library for noncreature artifacts and put them onto the battlefield.

339-677-2438-8296.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Jegantha, putting a +1/+1 counter on Carrion Feeder
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

4186-4279-6794.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least two additional creatures.
Scurry Oak has no +1/+1 counters on it.
Your life total is at least 2.
4186-4279-6794.description:
Cast Yawgmoth by paying {2}{B}{B}.
When Yawgmoth enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Holding priority, activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Susurian Voidborn triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on Scurry Oak and causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Scurry Oak trigger, creating a 1/1 Squirrel creature token.
When the Squirrel enters the battlefield, Scurry Oak's evolve ability triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it, triggering Scurry Oak's second ability.
Repeat from step 7.

2486-4694-7306-8227.notablePrerequisites:
You control your commander.
You have at least seven cards in your graveyard.
You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
2486-4694-7306-8227.description:
Activate Loot by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Master Chef.
Resolve Loot's ability, giving them -2/-0 until end of turn.
Repeat from step 1.

1531-4279-5075--216.easyPrerequisites:
The undying creature doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it.
Your life total is 2 or higher.
1531-4279-5075--216.description:
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing the undying creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter, Ogre Slumlord and the undying creature's undying ability trigger.
Resolve the Deathgreeter trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Ogre Slumlord ability, creating a 1/1 Rat creature token.
Resolve the undying trigger, returning the creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on any creature and drawing a card.
Activate Yawgmoth by paying 1 life and sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Deathgreeter triggers, causing you to gain 1 life 
Resolve the Yawgmoth ability, putting a -1/-1 counter on the undying creature and drawing a card.
Repeat.

1927-2459-3661-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
1927-2459-3661-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more +1/+1 counters on it

2060-2762-6751-6792.description:
Activate Thopter Squadron's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Thopter artifact creature token.
When the Thopter enters, Mm'menon triggers twice due to Starfield Vocalist, putting a +1/+1 counter on Thopter Squadron and Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

1818-3490-4050-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1818-3490-4050-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Healer of the Pride triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

206-3259-6664.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
You control five or more Towns.
206-3259-6664.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, The Wandering Minstrel triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

1453-3698-4559-7306.notablePrerequisites: Noncreature artifacts you control have total mana value 11 or greater.
1453-3698-4559-7306.description:
Cast Metalwork Colossus by paying {0}, which enters with at least two +1/+1 counters on it due to Arwen.
When Metalwork Colossus enters, Grinding Station triggers, untapping Grinding Station
Activate Grinding Station by tapping it and sacrificing Metalwork Colossus.
When Metalwork Colossus dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen token for each +1/+1 counter Metalwork Colossus had.
When the Mutagens enter, Grinding Station triggers that many times, untapping Grinding Station
Resolve the Grinding Station ability from step 3.
Activate Metalwork Colossus by sacrificing two Mutagens, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

2457-4289-6753-7297.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens.
Activate the creature tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Repeat

2653-2893-6168-6763.description:
Activate Fertilid by paying {1}{G} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, causing you to search your library for a basic land card and put it on the battlefield untapped due to Horizon Explorer.
When the basic land enters, Nissa and Obuun trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {G}.
Resolve the Obuun trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on Fertilid.
Activate the basic land by tapping it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with four or more quest counters on it

5261-6587-6588-7012.description:
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Moonmist without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Moonmist, transforming Ultimecia, Time Sorceress into Ultimecia, Omnipotent.
Ultimecia, Omnipotent triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
At the beginning of your end step, Airbender Ascension triggers, blinking Ultimecia, Omnipotent and causing it to re-enter the battlefield as Ultimecia, Time Sorceress.
Whenever Ultimecia, Time Sorceress enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to surveil 2.
Repeat each turn.

141-2885.easyPrerequisites: There are legal target(s) for Pegasus Guardian // Rescue the Foal.
141-2885.description:
Cast Pegasus Guardian // Rescue the Foal by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Pegasus Guardian // Rescue the Foal, with the copy targeting Naru Meha.
Resolve the copy of Pegasus Guardian // Rescue the Foal, blinking Naru Meha.
Repeat from step 3.

681-1669-4826-6621.easyPrerequisites: Lands you control excluding Mirrorpool can tap to produce at least {2}{C}
681-1669-4826-6621.description:
Cast Splendid Reclamation by paying {3}{G}.
Holding priority, activate any number of lands you control except Mirrorpool by tapping them, adding at least {2}{C}.
Activate Thaumatog by sacrificing a land other than Mirrorpool.
Repeat step 3 until Mirrorpool is the only land you control.
Activate Mirrorpool's second ability by paying {2}{C}, tapping and sacrificing it, copying Splendid Reclamation.
Resolve the Splendid Reclamation copy, returning all land cards from your graveyard to the battlefield untapped due to Archelos.
Repeat from step 2.

483-2292-5220-6900.description:
Activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing it.
When Viscera Seer dies, Mortuary and Cruel Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Viscera Seer from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Cruel Celebrant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability.
Cast Viscera Seer from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
Repeat.

uses.n: Birgi, God of Storytelling // Harnfel, Horn of Bounty

392-1387-1500-2871-4258.description:
Cast Seething Anger with buyback by paying {R}. Birgi, Blood Funnel and Sedgemoor Witch trigger.
Resolve the Birgi trigger, adding {R}.
Resolve the Sedgemoor Witch trigger, creating a 1/1 Pest creature token.
Resolve the Blood Funnel trigger, causing you to sacrifice the Pest token.
When the Pest dies, it triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Seething Anger spell.
Repeat.

5189-5231-6164.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a removable +1/+1 counter on it.
5189-5231-6164.description:
Activate Ghave's first ability by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from a creature you control, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
When the Saproling enters the battlefield, Yorvo triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Saproling, adding {R}.
Repeat.

1987-3617-4125-4423.notablePrerequisites: You control at least four Islands.
1987-3617-4125-4423.description:
Activate Mystic Sanctuary by tapping it, adding {U}.
Cast Time Walk by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Mystic Sanctuary and Shipwreck Dowser.
When Shipwreck Dowser and Mystic Sanctuary enter the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Shipwreck Dowser trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Mystic Sanctuary trigger, putting Time Walk from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Move to your next turn, drawing Time Walk during your draw step.
Repeat.

2511-2719-5756.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Sakashima of a Thousand Faces.
When Sakashima of a Thousand Faces dies, it and Havi trigger.
Resolve the Havi trigger, returning Sakashima of a Thousand Faces from your graveyard to the battlefield as a copy of Havi.
Resolve the Sakashima of a Thousand Faces trigger, returning any legendary creature card with mana value 5 or less from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat.

81-4659-5365-5494.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional artifact
81-4659-5365-5494.description:
Activate Lonis by paying {2} and sacrificing another artifact.
If the artifact was a Clue, Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Resolve the Lonis ability, putting two +1/+1 counters on it and causing you to draw a card.
Lonis' second ability triggers, creating two Clue artifact tokens.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Clue, adding {C}{C}.
Lonis' third ability triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on any other creature you control.
Repeat.

1242-2092-4289-4762.notablePrerequisites: Agatha of the Vile Cauldron has power 4 or greater.
1242-2092-4289-4762.description:
Activate Agatha of the Vile Cauldron by paying {R}{G}, giving all other creatures you control +1/+1, trample and haste until end of turn.
Activate Devoted Druid and Cinderhaze Wretch by tapping them, adding {R}{G}.
Activate Devoted Druid and Cinderhaze Wretch's second abilities by putting a -1/-1 counter on them, untapping them.
Repeat.

2713-4772-5115.description:
Activate Gemstone Array's first ability by paying {1}, putting two charge counters on it.
Activate Gemstone Array's second ability by removing a charge counter from it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

3259-4702.notablePrerequisites:
Breath of Fury attached to a creature you control that can attack this turn.
Splinter Twin attached to another nonlegendary creature you control without summoning sickness.
An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4702.description:
During your combat phase, before attackers are declared, activate the creature with Splinter Twin attached by tapping it, creating a token copy of the creature with haste.
Deal combat damage to an opponent using the creature with Breath of Fury attached.
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature with Breath of Fury attached, then attach Breath of Fury to a creature token you control, untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

541-2104-3634-3879.description:
Cast Temporal Manipulation by paying {3}{U}{U}, granting you an extra turn after this one and exiling it due to rebound.
At the beginning of your next upkeep, rebound triggers, causing you to cast the exiled spell without paying its mana cost.
Activate Portal of Sanctuary by tapping it and paying {1}, returning Venser to your hand.
Cast Venser by paying {2}{U}{U}.
When Venser enters the battlefield, they trigger, returning the extra turn spell to your hand.
Repeat each turn.
